S43.01.note: The attach path exists, but the upload scanner webhook (UPLOAD_SCAN_WEBHOOK_URL) is only confirmed in code; a live check is needed.
steps: Open a new chat in the web app.
Open the plus menu in the message box and click "Add photos & files".
Choose one image file.
Type a question about the image, such as "What is in this picture?", and send.
Look for an answer that describes the image. Expected: the model answers from the image, with no upload refusal message.
S43.01.where: Chat > composer plus menu > Add photos & files > choose one image > type a question > send

S43.02.note: Whether the picker accepts more than one file in one pick is not checked in the files read.
steps: Open a new chat in the web app.
Open the plus menu and click "Add photos & files".
Choose two or more image files at once.
Type "Compare these two images" and send.
Look for an answer that names details from both images. Expected: the model received and compared all attached images.
S43.02.where: Chat > composer plus menu > Add photos & files > choose two or more images > type a comparison question > send

S43.03.note: Whether Attach clipboard accepts an image on the clipboard was not confirmed; pasting into the message box was not traced.
steps: Take a screenshot with the macOS screenshot keys and leave it on the clipboard.
Open a new chat and open the plus menu.
Click "Attach clipboard" (or use "Add photos & files" and pick the screenshot file).
Type "What does this screenshot show?" and send.
Look for an answer that explains what is on the screen. Expected: the model describes the screenshot.
S43.03.where: Chat > composer plus menu > Attach clipboard (after copying a screenshot), or Chat > Add photos & files > choose a screenshot file

S43.04.needs: a photo or scanned PDF of a document
S43.04.note: Whether a scanned PDF is accepted as an image was not confirmed in the files read.
steps: Open a new chat and open the plus menu.
Click "Add photos & files" and choose a photo or a scanned PDF of a document.
Type "Read this document and explain it." and send.
Look for an answer that reads text from the document and explains it. Expected: the model reads the scanned document.
S43.04.where: Chat > composer plus menu > Add photos & files > choose a photo or scanned PDF > type "Read this document and explain it" > send

steps: Open a new chat and open the plus menu.
Click "Add photos & files" and choose a chart image.
Type "What trend does this chart show?" and send.
Look for an answer that names the data series and the trend. Expected: the model interprets the chart.
S43.05.where: Chat > composer plus menu > Add photos & files > choose a chart image > type a question about trends > send

steps: Open a new chat and open the plus menu.
Click "Add photos & files" and choose a diagram image.
Type "Explain the structure of this diagram." and send.
Look for an answer that names the parts and how they connect. Expected: the model explains the diagram structure.
S43.06.where: Chat > composer plus menu > Add photos & files > choose a diagram image > type "Explain the structure of this diagram" > send

steps: Open a new chat and open the plus menu.
Click "Add photos & files" and choose a photo of handwritten notes.
Type "Transcribe these notes." and send.
Look for a transcription that matches the handwriting. Expected: the model transcribes or answers about the notes.
S43.07.where: Chat > composer plus menu > Add photos & files > choose a photo of handwritten notes > type "Transcribe these notes" > send

S43.08.note: There is no separate OCR control; extraction is done by asking in the chat.
steps: Open a new chat and open the plus menu.
Click "Add photos & files" and choose an image that contains text.
Type "Extract the text in this image." and send.
Select the text in the reply and copy it, then paste it somewhere.
Look for the copied text to match the text in the image. Expected: the text can be copied and reused.
S43.08.where: Chat > composer plus menu > Add photos & files > choose an image with text > type "Extract the text in this image" > send, then copy the reply

steps: Open a new chat and open the plus menu.
Click "Add photos & files" and choose an image with a countable number of items.
Type "How many of these are in the image?" and send.
Count the items yourself and compare with the answer. Expected: the model gives a count.
S43.12.where: Chat > composer plus menu > Add photos & files > choose an image with several items > type "How many are there?" > send

S43.13.note: Multi-file selection in one pick was not confirmed in the files read.
steps: Open a new chat and open the plus menu.
Click "Add photos & files" and choose two scene images at once.
Type "Describe the differences between these two scenes." and send.
Look for an answer that names differences in both images. Expected: the model describes the differences.
S43.13.where: Chat > composer plus menu > Add photos & files > choose two scene images > type "Describe the differences" > send

S43.14.needs: a photo or screenshot of a problem
steps: Open a new chat and open the plus menu.
Click "Add photos & files" and choose a photo or screenshot of a device, error or setup.
Type "What is wrong here and what should I try?" and send.
Look for numbered troubleshooting steps that refer to the picture. Expected: the model gives troubleshooting steps.
S43.14.where: Chat > composer plus menu > Add photos & files > choose a photo or screenshot of the problem > type "What is wrong and what should I try?" > send

S43.17.needs: a previously saved image in the library
S43.17.note: Remix is a host action passed from apps/web/features/library/components/LibraryView.tsx; the Edit and Variation chips are in apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ChatComposerNew.tsx and appear only in image mode.
steps: Click "Library" in the sidebar.
Open an image item in the library list.
Click "Remix" in its menu.
The new chat opens with the image attached. Check the image chip and the "Edit" or "Variation" option.
Type a change, such as "Make the sky red", and send. Expected: the image is used as the reference input for the new generation.
S43.17.where: Library > open an image item > Remix (then the composer opens with the image attached); or Chat > plus menu > Add from library > pick the image > Edit or Variation
